<?php
function peerShift227() { global $late, $owner; $late = 99; $owner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerSelectorBase227 {
    public string $text;
    public function __construct($value) { $this->text = $value; echo 'CTOR;'; return false; }
    public static function capture($saved, $marker) {
        echo 'CAPTURE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return $saved;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'SELECTOR-END;'; }
}
class PeerSelectorChild227 extends PeerSelectorBase227 {}
class PeerMagicBase227 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $kept; $kept = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
class PeerMagicChild227 extends PeerMagicBase227 {}
$owner = new PeerMagicChild227;
$prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $kept = null;
$result = $owner->MiSsInG(first: false, later: (
    \Closure::fromCallable([new PeerSelectorChild227($late), 'capture'])
)($late, peerShift227()));
echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept, ';'; unset($kept); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
